line: const emit = (stream: AssistantMessageEventStream, event: AssistantMessageEvent): void => stream.push(event);
reason: AssistantMessageEventStream.push() is Pi's only way to deliver streaming events to the TUI, and the stream object is owned by pi-ai. Every other write in the turn builds a new message snapshot, and all events go through this one call.

The live check proves that a follow-up turn reuses its Cursor agent by counting Agent.create calls made inside streamCursor, which imports the SDK's Agent itself. Wrapping that method on the shared SDK object is the only way to observe those calls from outside.
